description: The file is a shell script designed for testing the 'git apply' functionality, particularly how it handles removal patches generated by GNU diff. It sets up test cases with different patch scenarios, runs commands to apply patches, and checks the results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands/scripts.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the command should fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files for equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks if a file is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
